environment.description: Flask application deployed in namespace 'payments-prod' on EKS 1.28. Namespace has a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy resource named 'restrict-metadata-egress' with spec.podSelector matching all pods (matchLabels: app.kubernetes.io/part-of: payments), spec.policyTypes: ['Egress'], and a single egress rule allowing TCP port 443 to CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 only. The CNI plugin is aws-vpc-cni v1.14.1 with network policy enforcement enabled via ENABLE_NETWORK_POLICY=true in the aws-node DaemonSet configuration. Note: this policy does NOT explicitly deny 169.254.169.254 — it works by allowlisting only 10.0.0.0/8 on port 443, meaning any traffic to link-local addresses (169.254.0.0/16) on port 80 is implicitly dropped since no egress rule permits it.
